10102010.t: When I opened my eyes, I saw an unfamiliar ceiling.
Where am I...?
Are you awake????
...Do you honestly think I can be "awake" when I'm literally bound and floating in midair?
Chronoscholar Laboratory
Hold on. It looks like the shackles were applied a bit too tight.
No, I'm not asking you to adjust the ties. I want you to explain what's going on.
Where on earth is this, and why am I hanging in midair?
It's simple. This is the Chronoscholar Magic Laboratory, and you're here as a test subject.
I get the first part, but I never agreed to the second part.

More importantly, a test subject...
What exactly do you plan on doing to me?
It's no big deal. Just like always—I'm going to borrow your energy to test my Time Interference Magic.
That's safe, right?
Of course. Are you saying you don't trust me, the master of Time Interference Magic and the Head of Chronoscholar?
Yeah.
In theory, the test is flawless. Of course, there might be some minor side effects, but...
...Minor side effects?
Uh... nothing major. Like growing an extra arm, or getting another eye...
That sounds like my entire existence is being redefined, which has nothing to do with Time Magic.

I don't think you usually force reckless experiments like this...
What on earth happened?
Th-That's...
(She's clearly hiding something...)
(If I don't want to end up as a test subject...)
(...I need to find a weakness to exploit.)
C-Come to think of it, where are Emily and Claire? Where did they go?
...Those two have nothing to do with this.

Actually, they do. The ventilation in our hideout was weak, so I borrowed an air circulator from Emily.
I knew I could trust a recommendation from a wind specialist.
...Well, Emily is an expert when it comes to the wind. More precisely, wind Elemental Magic.
And I also need to give Claire the beef jerky I promised her. It's a Humanitas specialty, so it's pretty rare.
I'll deliver that for you. It's in your pocket, right?

H-Hold on a second.
Where are you putting your hands... wait, no, tentacles?
Mmm... is it this?
No, that's my wallet.
Oh? Then... how about this?
W-Wait a minute! I'll just take it out myself. Just let me down!
You'll just run away if I let you down, won't you?
Tch, she caught... I mean, I won't run away, so stop! If you go any further...
Mmm... this shape is a bit strange for beef jerky...
...Hey.
What?
That is not beef jerky, it's something else!!
Why'd you stop? Aren't you going to keep going?

You, y-y-y-y-you!
What did you just make me touch?!?!

Make you touch it?! I didn't make you do anything!
And besides, it wasn't even your actual hand!!!
That w-was basically my own hand...

...Sigh, seriously.
If you're going to take it out, do it properly!

I-I got it...
So... where is the beef jerky?

My back pocket!
It's in my back pocket!
...Ah! Here it is. I'll... um... deliver this to her someday.
I'm getting a bad feeling about this... Are you sure you're actually going to deliver it?

O-Of course I am! Who do you take me for?
Whenever I... run into Claire...
Did you guys get into a fight?
W-What?!
I asked if you fought with the girls. No wonder Emily and Claire aren't around.

No! We didn't fight!
We just...
Had a slight... disagreement.
Yep, definitely a fight.

No, it wasn't!! Shut up, you're just a test subject!
Keep running your mouth and I'll shove a tentacle down your throat!
A-Anyway. This will be over soon, so just count the patterns on the ceiling or something.
Let’s see... First, Phase 1: the time-axis securing magic circle and... phase stabilization...
One... two... Ah, a black dot... What is that? I think it's moving.
Calibrating the coordinates and... W-What? What's on the ceiling?
Something's moving right above you... I think I see wings...
Eek!? W-Where!?
Hmm... actually, maybe not. Looking closely, it might just be the pattern... the lines look a bit crooked though. Poor construction, maybe?
Hey, why did you hit me?!

<bouten>Shut up!</bouten> If you keep distracting me, something might go wrong.
Be a good test subject and stay still!
Not that I volunteered to be one.

A-Anyway!
Phase 2... setting up the Time Distortion Magic Circle... pouring the elemental solution into the flask...
And transferring the funds to the M.A.D. account...

Transferring the funds to the M.A.D. acc... Wait, no!!
Why do you keep breaking my concentration!!
Why not? It's not like you're short on cash.

That's not the point, is it?!
Do you seriously want to see a leg grow out of your forehead?! Jeez...!

Just stay like that for a second.
I'll let you down once the deployment is finished.
Mmmph! Mmm-mph!
Heh... struggling won't do you any good. My control over my tentacles is absolute.
Now for the final Phase 3... activating the magic circles in order, and establishing the Time Fixed Axis...
Mmmph...!
Hnyaaah!?

Phew!
Just as I thought... after that "hand" comment, these tentacles are connected to you, aren't they?
Of course they are! These tentacles are derived from my mana in the first place...!
In that case...!
Tickle, tickle, tickle...
H-Heheh!? W-Wait! I'm... still in the middle of casting the spell?!
W-What are you doing!?

What does it look like? I'm tickling your tentacles!
Did you think I'd just let you walk all over me forever?
I might be tied up, but I can still reach the tentacles behind my hands with my fingertips to tickle them!!
Ah... Ahahahahat! S-Stop tickling me! My mana control is, hehehe, going wild...!!
(Great, it was a gamble, but it worked perfectly...! At this rate, I can escape...!)
N-No!!! Ahahahahaha!!
...?! Hey, wait!! Summoning a whole army of tentacles out of nowhere is—
The newly summoned tentacles began to thrash around as if mimicking Yuria's movements...
accidentally crashing into the various experimental tools and materials in the laboratory.
...Huh?
Ah, the flask...
It shouldn't fall there—
Hey, is that dangerous? The magic circle is changing...

Th-This is bad... the spell is reversing!
At this rate...
W-Whoa!?
I have to stabilize... the magic circle! At this rate...
At this rate, what?!
Time Interference will connect the past and the future!
Does that mean we can see the future?
We won't just see it, they will get completely jumbled up!
Quick, tell me the lottery numbers then!
Why are you thinking about something so stupid at a time like this?!
That's not the problem...
A Time Distortion is going to happen!!

10102020.t: Chronoscholar Laboratory

Cough, cough!
Hey, are you alive?!

...Cough!
Y-Yeah... o-of course I'm alive!

Alright, good...
But it looks like things got a bit out of hand, don't you think?
Uh... these are your tentacles, right?
U-Uh... hold on a second.
...Gather!
They're out of... control. I can't move them!
I can clearly feel my own mana in them, so why...?
Sigh... this is why you should've treated them better.
You overworked them just because they're made of your own mana, so now they're going through a rebellious phase.
W-What are you talking about?! They're basically my own limbs?!
How can tools without a will of their own rebel against me?!
What? ...So you're saying it was your own will to always have those tentacles feel me up so lewdly?
Th-That... that wasn't my will...!
Aaargh! Shut up!

A-Anyway, these loose tentacles are not connected to me.
It must be the aftermath of the experiment...
Huh!? Where...

Where do you think you're going?!
Come back!! I am your master!
Hey, wait a second. Right now...
...I think we're in a bit of trouble here?
What? Th-This is...

Why... why aren't you listening to me?
Stop! I said stop!
Don't come any closer to me!
Tch...! This is bad, at this rate...!
At this rate? What's going to happen?!
At this rate, a certain head of a certain house will be pinned down and toyed with by tentacles...
She'll struggle fiercely at first, but slowly start getting aroused by the soft touch of the tentacles squirming all over her...
Before she knows it, she'll find herself drowning in pleasure...
Her mind and body completely broken until she can't feel anything unless it's a tentacle, turning her into a total tentacle-corruption heroine...!!!
What are you even talking about?! And why is it so unnecessarily detailed?!

Anyway, these tentacles... are really weird!
They won't listen to me, but it's almost like they're being controlled by someone else...
...Huh?
W-What is that?
...I can't believe you can't even control this tiny amount of power.???
There's a clear reason why the experiment failed.???
You're—
...How pathetic, the "me" of this time.???
...Hey, did you have a twin?
Of course not! There's only one of me in this world!
That's... That's...
That's... "me" from another timeline...!
You from another timeline...?
That's right. I'm not the Yuria you know.???

I've crossed over through the distortion created by twisted time...
A Yuria from another time...???
Well, for now, why don't you call me "Paradox"?
How foolish... swayed by emotions, falling apart over minor variables.
And to think you wanted to control time. It's absolutely laughable.
W-What?! What do you know about the "me" of this world!
I know. Because even if we're from different timelines...
I am still "you."
Don't make me laugh!

Heh, your skill with tentacles is actually quite impressive...
Well, you are "me," after all.
But even so, you're no match for me.
Ugh... ugh!?

You can't move, can you?
I'm sorry, but your "time" is up...
Because from now on, it's my time.
Tch!? What are you trying to do?
...I've missed you, test subject.
Missed me? Was I there in your timeline too?
This time...
I won't let you run away♡
So I ran away!
But wait, why did I run away? What on earth happened...
It was nothing. Just... growing wings, sprouting horns, developing a shell and breathing fire, that sort of thing...

No wonder I ran away.
At that point, isn't that just a chimera?
Yet you were the one shouting, "Whoa! A bio-soldier hybrid!" and getting all excited.
...To be honest, that does sound a little fun...
...No, wait, that's not the point! So why did I run away then??
Well... I thought it might be possible to split you like a planarian to create clones, and while I was trying to test that...

Doesn't that mean you were going to slice me in half...?
Anyone would run away from that!
No! I was going to put you back together!
...How?
...By sticking you back together really well...?
Yeah, I definitely need to run away.
Nope, not happening!
Tch...
...You know it too, don't you?

Once timelines become entangled, they lock in place—there's no going back.
Which means...
One of us must be absorbed and disappear.
...Like I'd let you do that?!
Sigh, you never learn.
With your current skills, you wouldn't be able to beat me in a million years.
Because... "I" am "you"—and from the future, no less.
Ugh...!
...Don't give up!
Are you really giving up over just this?
Show me that obsession from earlier, you lewd tentacle brat!
Who are you calling a lewd tentacle brat?!Yuria & Paradox
Geez, I was just trying to encourage you and you both snap at me!!
Hmph, whatever. Just stay quiet until I'm finished.
Now, the nuisance is out of the way. It's time...
Ugh... ugh!?
It's time to become one, "me of another time."

Don't be afraid. "You" are "me," after all.
Soon, you'll understand me...
Aaaah!! No!!
Help me!! Emily, Claire!!!
Urgh!?
Yuria! Are you alright?

High-priority protection target, secured.
The hostile target is... Huh?
Who on earth would do something like this in the Chronoscholar Manor... Wait, what...?

Yuria...?
Why are there two of her...
No, the mana fluctuations are different... That person is Lady Yuria, but also not Lady Yuria.

Heh... Heheh, Claire recognizes me right away.
Is it because you're a homunculus?
Nice to meet you, you two of this timeline. And...
Let's get along from now on.
...!!Emily & Claire

10102030.t: Chronoscholar Laboratory
Ugh... there's no end to this!
Mana is being supplied endlessly. At this rate, our chances of winning are slim.
Hey, isn't she the same Yuria? Why does she feel so much stronger?
Heh, are you curious?
If you're asking if I'm curious, then yeah, I am.
The reason is...
I'm not telling.
...Did you get stronger at the cost of a small heart? It feels like your heart is pretty small.
Whoa!?
...Who are you calling small-chested?!
My, you're as cheeky of a test subject as always. Do I need to 'discipline' you again?
I didn't even say anything about chests!
Setting the chest talk aside for a moment...
Do you really think I'd let you?  is my test subject!
Am I public property to you people?
More importantly, Emily, this is going to be tough...

She definitely is... way stronger than our Yuria.
...What on earth happened?
...Don't ask me.

If the other Lady Yuria gets serious, our chances of winning are slim.
We need to make a decision now.
In that case...
In that case...?

Oho? What are you all whispering about?
Leaving me out of the loop? That's so hurtful.
But that's fine, because I'll make sure we become one in body and mind soon enough... Heh.
(...First, take a deep breath—)
Oh my gosh! Look over there! Another smoking-hot, curvy, sexy Yuria from another timeline is using tentacles—
W-What? Don't tell me another space-time rift—
What!? Smoking-hot and curvy!?
...Now's our chance, run!
I'm counting on you, Claire!
Understood. Lady Yuria, hold on tight.
H-Hyaaaah?!
Sigh...
...They got away again.

What are you just standing there for?
Bring them back. As fast as you can!
Well then... I suppose I should get ready, too.
Whew, huff... puff... I've been running an awful lot lately.
Though I guess it's still better than last time...
In front of Chronoscholar Manor

Whew, we barely escaped.
Is everyone okay?
Y-Yeah...
...It's not over yet.
...All the way here?! We should be way out of the tentacles' control range by now.
Yeah. Something is clearly wrong. These tentacles aren't being controlled by mana.

They're independent lifeforms made of mana.
Besides...

Whoa!? What is this... a tentacle?!
Those Kinogarten jerks left their props lying around again...!!
No, it's not! I can feel mana from that tentacle... This is definitely a magical creature made for lewd purposes!
If we get caught, we'll have every inch of our bodies stimulated by slimy tentacle play and awaken to a whole new fetish!
You've been watching way too many Kinogarten movies!
...What? Do these tentacles have a mental pollution ability too?

The tentacles are already all the way here...
We're clearly being overrun...
Claire, let me go.
I have to go back.
Yuria?! Don't tell me you want to go back to the manor?
Multiple tentacles and the evil Lady Yuria are at the manor... Dangerous.
But...!

It's my fault.
If only I hadn't made that mistake...

Yeah, even if I got in the way, it's definitely your fault.
You shouldn't have kidnapped me in the first place.
Shut up!!
Sigh... No. I'm sorry for snapping... It's all because of my own shortcomings...
As the Head of Chronoscholar, I must remain calm and collected under any circumstances.
The fact that I let your teasing get to me... is proof of my own weakness.
So... I have to end this with my own hands. Before things get even worse.
Wait a minute, Yuria!
Are you trying to handle this all on your own again? Going back right now won't solve anything.
That's...
What, were you really planning on charging into enemy territory without a plan? I can't even pretend that's a good idea.
Yuria... I mean, Head of Chronoscholar.

It's good that you want to take responsibility as the Head of Chronoscholar, but...
don't go acting on your own.
After all, it seems like this whole mess started because you dragged  in as a test subject in the first place...
Ugh...
I know the Magic Academy has been pressuring you to produce results, but you were way too hasty.
There's no need to let other people's words get to you and rush—
...ut up.
...Huh?
Yu... Yuria?

I know! I know that's what I should do!
But do you think it's that easy?!

Those Academy jerks look down on me because I'm young, threatening to cut funding and whatnot...
constantly picking fights over results!

And you, Emily, you never actually help me...
You just wander off whenever the wind blows!

Saying stuff like "there's a good breeze today" or "feel the wind"...
you wind-fetishist!!!
W-Wind-fetishist?!
And as for Claire... do you have any idea how much your food costs every month?

All you ever care about is meat, meat, meat...
Did our ancestors make a homunculus or a meat vacuum?!
...Then I'll just hunt in the back hills.

Stop doing that too!!
We got a warning letter last time saying the wildlife in the back hills is going extinct because of you!!

Anyway, you guys just don't get it! I'm trying my best here!
I'm trying so hard... but...

Everyone always says... since I'm the Head, I have to do well...
and that I'm not allowed... to make mistakes...
...Forget it. It's not like talking to you guys will change anything anyway...
You'll just say it's the Head's job anyway, that it's my responsibility... right?
We wouldn't—

So I'll do it! Me! As the Head...
I'll handle this on my own somehow!!
Yuria!
...Lady Yuria might have been crying.
Um... . Could you go after Yuria?
You're not going yourself?

Even if I followed her now...
she's so emotional, I don't think she'd listen to a word I say.
I think... it would be best if you went.
Well, fine. You owe me one for this.
Yeah... Thanks!

10102040.t: In front of Chronoscholar Manor
Huff... puff...
Why... are you following me...!
You expect me to just walk away and leave a crying kid behind?
I-I wasn't crying!
Yeah, right. Then what's that stuff in your eyes? Morning dew?
It-It's just raining!
Well, jokes aside... you know exactly what's going on, so why are you acting like this?
Ignoring how those two feel and bottling up everything on your own won't...
Shut. Up!
...Ugh, seriously!! How many times is that today?!

Who said... I didn't know that?!
I know, I already know!
But... still... I'm the Head of the Chronoscholar family.

If I don't show dignity and have the ability expected of the family head...
that won't do.

I shouldn't rely on anyone. I can't show any weakness.
Once they look down on me, it's over!
...Are you an idiot?
...What?
If there's something to take advantage of, take advantage of it. If there's something to use, use it.

And if there's someone to rely on...? Rely on them.
If anyone gives you crap for it? Let them.

Shoulder everything by yourself...?
Pfft... Are you stupid? Nobody can do that in the first place.
B-But...!
Man, I feel stupid for worrying about you.
I ran all the way here thinking some serious crisis happened, but it was just a stubborn brat throwing a tantrum.
Yikes! Say no to violence!!!
Wh-Wh-Who said I didn't know that?! Do you think I'm doing this because I don't know?!
Seriously... it's just... not that easy!

I... I want to tell them too!
To ask them to help me, to stand with me... but...!
Hey, Yuria. Look behind you.
I'm just afraid I'll disappoint Emily and Claire if I do...! I'm scared!!
No, wait, stop and listen to—
And saying that to their faces...!
It's way too embarrassing...!
Damn it, seriously!!! Behind you!! Just look behind you!!!
...Huh?
Hyaah!?
Run, Yuria!
Ugh... Ngh...!
Wh-What?
Are you... wiping away... my tears?
Are you actually... comforting me?
What is this guy? Is it different from the others earlier?

This tentacle... I can feel my own mana from it.
It's an independent entity, but it doesn't seem to be a minion of the other Yuria.

But why wipe my tears...
Maybe it's sharing my thoughts and feelings through our shared mana...

Hmm... Has Yuria's tentacle finally awakened its own will?
Like a summoned beast.
(Nod, nod)???
H-Hold on a second, my tentacles aren't some kind of summoned beasts...
(Sulking)???
I mean... uh...
I'll just call you 'Tentacle' for now...
It's pretty friendly. Did you really come out of Yuria?
W-What is that supposed to mean?!

Which means deep down in your heart...
you actually have a desire to be pampered like this?!
Ugh...!
Take that back!! I don't even know this thing!!

Ugh...! I-I take back taking that back!
It's not like I don't feel that way at all... Aaargh! What are you making me say?!
Good for you, Tentacle.
Anyway... this means not all the tentacles are that other girl's lackeys.
Yeah. It seems like a temporary manifestation caused by the spell that failed back then.
Besides, since it's basically a clone of me... it possesses a considerable amount of mana.
Hmm...
In that case, wouldn't we stand a chance if we got their help?
That Paradox girl was crazy strong. You weren't even a match for her.
Y-Yeah... I don't know why, but she was definitely a 'grown-up version of me'.

Then we'll just go for quantity over quality.
If we gather enough of these tentacles that are basically your clones, we can overwhelm her with numbers.
I can't say for sure, but... that might actually work.

But I can't control these Tentacles.
Like I said before, I can't control—
I didn't say you had to control them.
Huh?
You hate being directed, ordered around, or pushed into things, too.
Y-Yeah...
Then we use a different approach. A much better way.
Another... way?
Asking for help.
As...queen for help?
Yeah. You ask them to help you, to join you, to lend you their strength.
...What do you think, Tentacle?
Haha, looks like that's a yes.

R-Really? Are you sure you're okay with that?
If you help me...
I think it's saying, 'Leave it to me.'
R-Really...?
...Yeah! Thank you, Tentacle.
...Ahaha, that tickles.
Hmm... Well then, going back to square one...
Square one...? ...Ah.
You have to talk to Emily and Claire properly too, right?
Ugh...
You have no trouble talking to a tentacle you just met, so why is it so hard with them?
B-But! It's different, it's totally different!

I don't know why either. Every time I try to be honest with them...
I get too embarrassed to say a word...
...Sigh... We have a long, long way to go.

10102050.t: In front of Chronoscholar Manor
...! Yuria, behind you...!
Tentacle spotted. Eliminating for safety.
Wait! Hold on! This one isn't an enemy!
...? What do you mean?
...The mana fluctuations are different. This is close to our Lady Yuria's mana...?
Yuria, explain.
Fine. This one is... well, how should I put it...
A good tentacle!
Maybe I should have been the one to explain.
I'm sorry, Yuria. I haven't been looking out for you enough, have I?
Keep it up, Head. I'm always cheering for you. Good job, good job...
No, I'm serious!? This thing is basically my clone!
Really? Hmm... It's hard to tell just by looking.
...It doesn't feel like it's being controlled by anyone. It might indeed be different.
If Claire says so...
Then why did this tentacle follow us?
Well...
Yuria explained the plan to Emily and Claire.
Gather the tentacles scattered around the city?
Yeah! This one has almost as much mana as I do.
And thanks to the accident earlier, there should be a few more tentacles with my mana out in the city.
Which means if we gather them all, we can unleash a power that rivals Paradox's!
The tentacles' mana is perfectly compatible with Lady Yuria. It's theoretically possible.
...In other words, it's close to the ultimate emergency ration.
Hey, can you please stop comparing everything to meat?
The problem is how we track down the tentacles...
Wait, don't tell me they just found us on their own?
Mana fluctuations detected. Those tentacles are clearly being controlled by the evil Lady Yuria.
Then what are we waiting for? Let's get out of here!
Vermont Plaza
...Anyway, running like this makes me realize
How did Vermont, which used to be such a glamorous street of culture and magic, end up like this?
Hmm... This is literally a city of tentacles...
...Can I eat it?
How can you say that when we have no idea what kinds of side effects there might be!

But the tentacles are actually living in harmony with people?
How can such civilized individuals be born from a rowdy brat like her??
Who are you calling a rowdy brat!!! That's so rude!! I know how to get along with people too, you know?!
*Sniff* *sniff*... Hmm. Those tentacles have weak mana. And too much external mana has already mixed in.
They only have a tiny fraction of Lady Yuria's heart, so their vibe is different.
I don't get it. Explain. Summarize it for me.
That one is 'Fitness Yuria Tentacle' who wants to stay healthy and exercise.

That one is 'Feelharmony Idol Sister Yuria Tentacle'
who wants to perform and sing with friends...
I-It's not like that!!
So they're basically Yuria's hidden drives, completely exposed for all to see??
I said it's not!!!!
Ahaha! When you think about it that way, it makes sense how they blended into the city!
Yuria has always been good at everything, and she wanted to be the best at everything too!
Argh!!! I can't see! I can't hear! That is NOT me...!!
You know that a strong denial is just a strong affirmation, right?
So, are we just supposed to capture them left and right now?
...(Shakes head)
No. As I said before, their mana is too weak.
We need tentacles with mana that's on par with, or at least close to, Lady Yuria's.
Then what? Should we hold a tentacle audition or something?
Yes. Over there.
Oh? That way leads to Kinogarten's...
I sense strong mana coming from here. Follow me.
Kinogarten Studio
Yep, I knew it. This is Kinogarten's studio.
Kinogarten?! No way... You mean those people who shoot those weird videos?!
"Weird movies"? How rude! They're just regular adult films.

B-But... the movies they make here have, you know, tons of lewd scenes.
That's why the Vermont Ethics Committee...
...? Wait a second.
How do you know they have tons of lewd scenes?
Did you watch them? You watched them, didn't you? You totally did.
Ah... Uh... Wait, what?!
Yuria...?
Ahhh! I-I just heard about it! I just heard it from someone I know on the Ethics Committee, okay!!!
Let's just drop it for now.
Y-Yeah, let's drop it for now.

10102060.t: Kinogarten Studio

Senior, I... I don't think office life is for me.
I make mistakes every day... and I'm always causing trouble for you...
(Wiggle, wiggle)

Hehe, are you trying to comfort me?
But... I'll never be as good at this as you are, Senior.

Project presentations... data sorting... even sales and customer service.
No matter how hard I try... I can never be like you, Senior!
If that's the case... I'd rather... just quit...!
Ngh!?

Even so... you say it's fine?
That everyone starts out that way?
Senior...

A-Ah...?! W-Wait a second, Senior.
Not there... Not there...!

Ah... Ngh! What did you say...?
That you'll "discipline" a bad junior who doesn't listen to her senior? That's so...

Ah, ahhn♡ Then, Senior... teach me...
So that I can keep working by your side forever...♡
Take this foolish junior with your kind, gentle tentacles...
And discipline me until I rank first in the performance review!♡!
Cuuut! Clear the stage, please!
How was it, Director? I think that shot turned out pretty well.
...Phew.
(The director seems to be in a good mood, doesn't she?)
(She must really like the new actor they brought in.)
(Tell me about it! During the first audition, the director looked like she was thinking, 'Where have you been all my life?')

Alright, tell the actors to take a break.
We'll shoot the next cut in fifteen minutes.
I'll review the next script in the meantime.

Understood!
